---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Rogue TD
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what feature or gameplay mechanism you would like to see implemented.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tower designs, or UI layouts you've considered.

## 🎮 Gameplay / Tactical Impact
How does this feature affect game balance, tactical depth, or performance across low-end and high-end Android hardware?

## ℹ️ Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup sketches, references, or links to related issues here.
